notes: Boss room (one page). Beam search scored on the boss's health ($1035, as in 1-2 and 5-4) and Ryu's health; ends when the boss health returns to 0; then idle (no input) through the boss death and the cinema to the next stage. The beam is pulled toward the boss's x ($2F1C, the first enemy slot as in 2-3) while it lives.
